evals.name: debug-react-use-effect-loop
evals.prompt: fix: my React component has an infinite loop with useEffect. The dependency array includes a function that changes every render. How do I fix this?
evals.expected_output: A response identifying the stale closure / unstable reference issue, suggesting useCallback for the function or useRef for stable references.

assertions.name: identifies-stale-reference
assertions.description: Identifies that the function in the dependency array changes every render

assertions.name: suggests-use-callback
assertions.description: Suggests useCallback to stabilize the function reference

assertions.name: uses-context7
assertions.description: Uses Context7 to fetch React docs (not just general knowledge)

assertions.name: includes-code-example
assertions.description: Provides a code example showing the fix

evals.name: debug-prisma-connection
evals.prompt: debug: my Prisma connection keeps failing with 'Can't reach database server'. I'm using PostgreSQL on Railway. The connection was working yesterday.
evals.expected_output: A response that checks connection string format, SSL requirements, IP whitelisting, and suggests using prisma db push to test connectivity.

assertions.name: checks-connection-string
assertions.description: Checks DATABASE_URL format and common issues

assertions.name: mentions-ssl
assertions.description: Mentions SSL/TLS requirement for cloud databases

assertions.name: suggests-db-push-test
assertions.description: Suggests npx prisma db push to test connectivity

assertions.name: references-prisma-debug
assertions.description: References the Prisma debugging reference file

evals.name: fix-python-import-error
evals.prompt: fix: when I run my Python script it says 'ModuleNotFoundError: No module named requests'. I installed it with pip but it still doesn't work.
evals.expected_output: A response that checks venv activation, pip list, Python interpreter mismatch, and suggests which python/pip check.

assertions.name: checks-venv-activation
assertions.description: Checks if the virtual environment is activated

assertions.name: checks-pip-list
assertions.description: Suggests running pip list to verify installation

assertions.name: checks-interpreter-mismatch
assertions.description: Checks for Python interpreter mismatch (terminal vs system)

assertions.name: references-python-debug
assertions.description: References the Python debugging reference file
